individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmaps show per-spot values directly on tissue, not an averaged summary statistic requiring overlaid individual points.
Box plots have individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group/category.
GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic per gene from differential expression analysis, not a mean of replicate measurements, so individual points are not applicable.
Panel consists of micrographs (H&E and IHC images), not a quantitative plot.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - spatial deconvolution maps display per-spot data, no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - caption defines box plot elements (25th-75th percentile) and additionally provides explicit minima, median, maxima, Q1 and Q3 values for each group.
not needed - GSEA enrichment plots show a running score curve with no error bars.
not needed - bar graph of log2 fold change values shows no error bars.
not needed - panel shows micrographs, no error bars present.
